name: Ramp
text:
Decision: Add a visible focus ring to every interactive element (buttons, links, form fields) so keyboard users can see where they are. This makes the site work for people who can’t use a mouse or rely on keyboard navigation.

Trade-off: The focus ring might feel “loud” to some sighted mouse users, but we’ll keep it subtle (thin, high-contrast) so it’s only obvious when needed. The clarity for keyboard users outweighs the minor visual noise.
